scope: Planar dynamic-body/ConfigurableJoint feasibility only; no human or network validation.
limitations: Gravity and pitch/roll disabled; fixed initial fixture anchors are NOT gameplay grab slots. No support, input validation, hanging, parking, fracture, camera, network or latency test.

checks.name: forward_motion
checks.criterion: 4 s displacement > 2 m, diagnostic threshold only

checks.name: minority_has_effect
checks.criterion: Opposing input changes final trajectory by > 0.5 m

checks.name: position_changes_turn_direction
checks.criterion: Same per-player inputs with mirrored anchors produce opposite yaw, > 10 degrees

checks.name: release_preserves_inertia
checks.criterion: First released step retains > 0.5 m/s, later damping reduces speed

checks.name: blocked_player_does_not_cross_wall
checks.criterion: Tracked front-left player stays behind wall front surface (z=1.075), allowing contact tolerance

checks.name: obstruction_affects_tank
checks.criterion: Obstruction reduces forward travel by at least 20 percent

checks.name: repeatability
checks.criterion: Same-process repeated forward run differs < 1 cm; not cross-machine determinism

checks.name: four_forward_bounded
checks.criterion: Finite state; grip error < 0.3 m; tank speed < 6 m/s; proxy speed < 8 m/s. Experiment limits, not gameplay acceptance.
